scope: Metadata inventory only; no new skill authority or runtime implementation

skills.name: Trailcraft
skills.description: Passive: +1 sight layer along the three forward rays; terrain still blocks sight.

skills.name: Flank Watch
skills.description: Passive: see the two immediately sideways squares. This does not change movement or attacks.

skills.name: Rear Watch
skills.description: Passive: see the three immediately rearward squares. This does not change movement or attacks.

skills.name: Forest Lore
skills.description: Passive: your sight rays penetrate forests, but never mountains.

skills.name: River Walker
skills.description: Passive: your normal pawn moves may enter water. Attacks remain forward-diagonal only.

skills.name: Mountaineer
skills.description: Passive: your normal pawn moves may enter mountains. Mountains still block sight beyond them.

skills.name: Signal Post
skills.description: Action: place a temporary radius-2 sight beacon at your square for four opposing response turns. Costs normal CP; 3-friendly-turn cooldown.

skills.name: Summit Watch
skills.description: Passive: +1 forward sight layer while standing on a mountain; the normal sight cap remains six.

skills.name: Long Sight
skills.description: Passive: +1 forward sight layer, stacking with Trailcraft up to the normal cap of six.

skills.name: Sentry Platform
skills.description: Passive: a friendly watchtower gains one outer sight ring only while you are standing on it. Terrain blocks extended sight.

skills.name: Far Signal
skills.description: Action: place a radius-3 sight beacon for four opposing response turns. Shares the Signal Post cooldown.

skills.name: Lasting Signal
skills.description: Action: place a radius-2 sight beacon for six opposing response turns. Shares the Signal Post cooldown.

skills.name: Woodsman
skills.description: Passive: forest clearing takes one friendly work turn instead of two.

skills.name: Bridgewright
skills.description: Passive: bridge construction takes one friendly work turn instead of two. Level-2 work gate remains.

skills.name: Masonry
skills.description: Passive: mountain excavation takes two friendly work turns instead of three. Level-3 gate remains.

skills.name: Campwright
skills.description: Passive: camp construction takes two friendly work turns instead of three. Level-4 gate remains; recruitment clocks are separate.

skills.name: Towerwright
skills.description: Passive: watchtower construction takes one friendly work turn instead of two. Level-2 gate remains.

skills.name: Land Reclamation
skills.description: Passive: at level 2+, unlock the engineer-style water-fill project (one work turn), from an adjacent visible shore.

skills.name: Tunnelcraft
skills.description: Passive: at level 3+, unlock tunnel construction through an adjacent visible mountain (three work turns).

skills.name: Quarry Master
skills.description: Passive: mountain excavation takes one friendly work turn. Replaces, rather than stacks below, the Masonry reduction.

skills.name: Road Crew
skills.description: Passive: forest clearing may target an adjacent visible square instead of only the square underfoot.

skills.name: Field Survey
skills.description: Passive: build watchtowers on an adjacent visible, vacant plain square. You remain at the work position.

skills.name: Site Planner
skills.description: Passive: build camps on an adjacent visible, vacant plain square. Level-4 gate remains; you must enter the completed camp to operate it.

skills.name: Instructor
skills.description: Passive: keeping this pawn stationed for a training batch takes four friendly turns instead of five. Sacrifice stays two; recruits stay level 1.

skills.name: Cover
skills.description: Action: protect one adjacent friendly pawn, knight, bishop or rook from one attack through the next enemy turn. No king/queen targets, no stacking. Normal CP; 3-friendly-turn shared guard cooldown.

skills.name: Sidestep
skills.description: Action: move one square sideways without capturing, only through explored passable terrain. Normal CP; 2-friendly-turn shared maneuver cooldown.

skills.name: Withdraw
skills.description: Action: move one square straight backward without capturing. Known passable route required. Normal CP; shared maneuver cooldown.

skills.name: Forced March
skills.description: Action: move two squares straight forward without capturing or jumping blockers. Both squares must be explored. Normal CP; shared maneuver cooldown.

skills.name: Diagonal March
skills.description: Action: move two squares along one forward diagonal without capturing or jumping blockers. Known passable route required. Normal CP; shared maneuver cooldown.

skills.name: Entrench
skills.description: Action: protect yourself from one attack through the next enemy turn. Normal CP; shared guard cooldown. No stacking.

skills.name: Relief
skills.description: Action: swap with an adjacent, unacted friendly pawn/knight/bishop/rook. Both must be idle and able to enter the other square. Pays BOTH activation costs and uses BOTH activations. Shared maneuver cooldown.

skills.name: Distant Cover
skills.description: Action: Cover a friendly pawn/knight/bishop/rook up to two squares away along clear line of sight. Same one-hit protection, CP and shared guard cooldown.

skills.name: Ready Guard
skills.description: Passive: guard actions recover after two friendly turns instead of three. Requires an equipped Cover, Distant Cover or Entrench action.

skills.name: Lasting Guard
skills.description: Passive: protection you grant lasts through two opposing response turns instead of one, but still absorbs only ONE attack.

skills.name: March Drill
skills.description: Passive: equipped maneuver skills may be used on consecutive friendly turns. Never grants a second activation in the same turn.

skills.name: Support Training
skills.description: Passive: when your granted protection actually absorbs an attack, earn 1 base XP once per protected ally per match. No XP for merely casting protection.
